articles.title: Fed Subpoenas Revive ‘Sell America’ Trade on Autonomy Concerns
articles.mainIdea: Fed Subpoenas Revive ‘Sell America’ Trade on Autonomy Concerns
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Fed Subpoenas Revive ‘Sell America’ Trade on Autonomy Concerns. The dollar, Treasuries and US equities futures all slid in early Asia trading after Chair Jerome Powell said the threat of a US criminal indictment — related to his congressional testimony on renovations at the Fed’s headquarters — was a consequence of a disagreement over monetary policy. The action is the latest in a series of confrontations against the central bank, from efforts to fire Governor Lisa Cook to repeated calls for aggressive interest rate cuts.
